description: Held N=4096 and k=50 fixed; swept only the Pisot phase damp (1-|psi|^n). Independent recomputation.
interpretation: The Lucas/Pisot phase damp converges to the identity. It is a convergent-to-identity perturbation, not a scaling advantage. The quadratic advantage of the coined walk is from the walk being quantum, not from the ratio being golden.
edge_case: n=76 in the matched-N run produced P_folded_damped=0.00003272 because k exceeded ITERATION_CAP; the damped iterate does not converge to the canonical peak in that regime.
